notes.note: Reviewed affected intake claims after exact6b iOS compiled/launched but its clean-install XCUITest found the invitation-rejection dialog instead of the no-connection shell. Retained runtime receipt/artifact and actual shipped Info.plist show no scene manifest. Checksum-verified pinnedTao0.37.1 registers the scene-configuration method unconditionally; Station previously equated its presence with multiple-scenes-enabled. Source correction requires the actual callback and validates its ABI, retaining main-thread/ownedAppDelegate/UIResponder class, launch/open/scene argument and return types,ownedSceneDelegate,duplicate-install,forwarding and authority guards. The obsolete Info.plist equivalence is removed; no iOS test deadline or acceptance predicate changed. Native-shell guide now states the version-bound callback contract. Runtime logs do not retain the failing hook stage, so source-contract evidence is distinct from an observed stage log. Formatting/whitespace/source review establishes code scope only; no local iOS build, installed interaction, physical device, provider or canonical proof claimed. Current native runtime/setup capacity remains below10GiB floor; no source/baseline/proof deletion or duplicate native campaign. Cold/warm/invalid-link and actual new-head hosted acceptance remain required after normalgates/publication.
